Cosmetic · Patient guide

Dental veneers in Gujranwala

Veneers are thin facings used to change the appearance of selected front teeth.

Ask about an appointment →

When might I need it?

Ask about veneers if a front tooth is chipped, discoloured or uneven. Depending on your goals, bonding, whitening or orthodontics may also be worth discussing.

What age group is it for?

Generally considered for adults with stable teeth and healthy gums. The dentist checks your bite and habits such as grinding.

What happens at the appointment?

The dentist plans the shape and shade. Some veneers require enamel preparation, impressions or scans, and a later fitting. Ask about maintenance and replacement.

Does it hurt?

Preparation may require numbing. Some people notice temporary sensitivity. Ask how much tooth structure the proposed option would remove.

How much does it cost?

The quote depends on the material, how many teeth are being treated and any planning or temporary veneers. Ask for the per-tooth and total cost.

For current pricing and availability, ask the clinic for a quote in PKR based on your assessment.

Plan your visit

Ask the team about availability, the consultation fee, and what to bring. Wait for reception to confirm the date and time.
